message: An exception of type '{1}' was thrown while {0}: {2}. Exception details are in '{3}'. To attach a debugger to the compiler, use the '-p:MetalamaDebugCompiler=True' command-line option.
title: An exception was thrown by user code.
rationale: The message starts with a stray quote (''Exception of type'), lacks an article and verb ('Exception of type ... thrown while'), and contains a double space before the command-line option (the C# concatenation adds a space twice). The title is a noun phrase, not a sentence.
codeChange: When no crash report is written (UserCodeInvoker.OnException, line 123), the report site passes '(none)' as {3}, which renders as 'Exception details are in '(none)''. Consider passing a complete sentence fragment, or a separate message variant, when there is no report file.
